title: Memo - Enquiries Re F. Sgt. No. 27 E.G.H. Halwell

page_data.en:
CONFIDENTIAL
(CKD.) Office Notes
SECRET & CONFIDENTIAL

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTER
File No. L. O. D. 1276
Date 6. 30.

Enquiries re F. Sgt. No. 27 E. G. H. Halwell
attached to Recording Staff of the Municipal Advocates Office.
----------
May 3rd., 1930.

Sir,

Acting on instructions received from Mr. R. C. Aiers D.C.
(C. and S. Branches) per Det. Insp. J. Hunter on May 2nd 1930
enquiries were made by the undersigned, Det. Sgt. Barton and Jap.
Det. Sgt. Unemoto for F. Sgt. Eustace George Hogan Halwell,
who had been missing since April 30th 1930.

F. Sgt. Halwell's wife was interviewed by me at her home
at No. 162, Sinza Road, on the morning of above date, and she
informed me that she had last seen her husband about 1.30 p.m.
on April 30th 1930. At this particular time he left home on
his way to the Shanghai Special District Court. Previous to
his departure then she discovered an "Advice" note, which had
come in by post on same date, from the China Finance Corporation,
4 Hankow Road, and it was advising him that $85 was due on May
1st 1930 on the promissory note, which he had signed. This
caused Mrs. Halwell to have a straight talk with him re his financial worries, because she had noticed he had been very moody
and peculiar during the past fortnight. However, he had arranged to meet her shortly after 4 p.m. on same date, and go with
her to the China Finance Corporation and square up the account
for the aforementioned sum, and he left with his pay cheque.
Since then she had not seen or heard of him.

Enquiries were made by the undersigned at the China
Finance Corporation(Fed. Inc. U.S.A.) 4, Hankow Road, where
Mr. H. A. Keays was interviewed. He admitted to me, in confidence, that F. Sgt. Halwell had got a loan of money from the concern and so far had not appeared to pay his first instalment.
He had signed 12 promissary note for $1000 which had to be paid
back at the rate of $85 per month from May 1930 to March 1931
and $65 on March 1931. He had actually borrowed $800 and the

绝密及机密

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记簿
档案编号 L. O. D. 1276
日期 6月30日

关于附属于市公署律师办公室记录股的警佐（外籍）第27号 E. G. H. Halwell 的查询。
----------
1930年5月3日。

先生：

根据1930年5月2日通过侦探督察 J. Hunter 收到的 R. C. Aiers 副总监（刑事与特别股）的指示，本人、侦探警佐 Barton 以及日本侦探警佐 Unemoto 对自1930年4月30日起失踪的外籍警佐 Eustace George Hogan Halwell 进行了查询。

上述日期上午，本人在其位于新闸路162号的家中会见了 Halwell 警佐的妻子，她告知本人，她最后一次见到丈夫是在1930年4月30日下午1点30分左右。当时他离家前往上海特区法院。在他出发前，她发现了一封当天通过邮政寄来的来自汉口路4号中国金融公司（China Finance Corporation）的“通知”便条，通知他于1930年5月1日到期支付他所签署的本票款项85美元。这促使 Halwell 夫人与他就其财务忧虑进行了一次坦率的谈话，因为她注意到他在过去两周里情绪非常低落且行为反常。然而，他已安排在同日下午4点后不久与她见面，并一同前往中国金融公司结清上述款项，他离开时携带了他的薪水支票。自那以后，她便再未见到或听到他的消息。

本人在汉口路4号的中国金融公司（美国联邦注册公司）进行了查询，并会见了 H. A. Keays 先生。他私下向本人承认，Halwell 警佐曾从该公司获得一笔贷款，但至今尚未支付首期款项。他签署了12张总额为1000美元的本票，需从1930年5月至1931年3月按每月85美元的利率偿还，1931年3月偿还65美元。他实际借款为800美元，另外

page_data.en:
2

$200 had been added on as interest. I saw the official papers
at the office showing the $1000, but Mr. H. A. Keays did not
state what the amount was tha F. Sgt. Halwell had been paid
over to him as a loan; but Mr. Gee, an employee of above con-
cern, told me that the actual amount paid out was $800. F. Sgt.
Fallwell, according to the official papers seen, contracted the
loan on March 7th 1930, and he mortgaged his house furniture and
effects on same. Mr. Gee went to his home on March 10th 1930
and valued the property there at $855. A letter of introduction
and guarantee, dated March 8th 1930, re Hallwell, written by
Dr. O. Fischer of Musso Fischer and Welhelm, 71, Szechuen Road,
was attached to the official papers also. During the period
this loan was contracted, Mrs. Halwell was in Nanking with friends
on holiday.

Det. Sgt. Barton made enquiries for F. Sgt. Halwell
on May 2nd 1930 at the shipping companies, and Thomas Cook's Ltd's
office, Nanking Road. No results. Enquiries were also made by
Japanese Detective Sgt. Unemoto at the Japanese Shipping Compa-
nies, which proved abortive.

About 4 p.m. on May 2nd 1930 Supt. Yorke attached to
the Municipal Advocates office informed me per phone that Halwell
had returned. Later Mr. R. C. Aiers D.C.(C. and S.B.) instructed the
undersigned to discontinue enquiries.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently
Alexander Telfer.
D.S.I.

（批：J.H. 3 5/30.）

MAY 5 1930

200美元作为利息附加在内。本人在办公室查看了显示1000美元金额的官方文件，但 H. A. Keays 先生并未说明支付给 Halwell 警佐的贷款具体金额是多少；但该公司的雇员 Gee 先生告诉本人，实际支付的金额为800美元。根据所见的官方文件，Halwell 警佐于1930年3月7日订立了该笔贷款，并以他的房屋家具及物品作为抵押。Gee 先生于1930年3月10日前往其家中，将那里的财产估值为855美元。一份由四川路71号 Musso Fischer and Welhelm 公司的 O. Fischer 医生于1930年3月8日出具的关于 Halwell 的介绍信及担保信也附在官方文件中。在这笔贷款订立期间，Halwell 夫人正与朋友在南京度假。

侦探警佐 Barton 于1930年5月2日在各轮船公司及南京路的通济隆有限公司（Thomas Cook's Ltd）办公室为 Halwell 警佐进行了查询。无结果。日本侦探警佐 Unemoto 也在各日本轮船公司进行了查询，但同样没有结果。

1930年5月2日下午4点左右，附属于市公署律师办公室的约克（Yorke）巡官通过电话通知我，Halwell 已经回来。随后，R. C. Aiers 副总监（刑事与特别股）指示本人停止查询。

此致，
敬礼
Alexander Telfer
侦探督察

（批注：J.H. 1930年5月3日。）
（批注：情报）
（批注：R.C.A. (首字母)）
（批注：5月3日）

1930年5月5日
